related.title: CESM/CIME：耦合器通量的面積守恆帳本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有同步、數值篩檢與對應科學診斷共同合格才放行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Release requires synchronization, numerical screening and the relevant scientific diagnostics together.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「CESM/CIME：耦合器通量的面積守恆帳本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付面元功率表、方向定義、重映射權重檢查及時間積分收支。
related.differenceEn: Investigate CESM/CIME: area-conservative coupler flux accounting using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver face-power tables, sign definitions, remapping-weight checks and a time-integrated budget that identifies every included and excluded energy pathway.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算十五秒內移動 900 m，再除子格寬；獨立計父網格的同一指標。
逐面計算二乘十及三乘二十，再相加；用五平方米與正確加權平均十六交叉核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate travel of 900 m during a child step and divide by child spacing. Independently compute the parent indicator and explain why proportional refinement preserves this particular horizontal transport ratio.
Compute each face contribution and sum them. Cross-check using total area five and weighted mean flux sixteen, distinguishing the weighted mean from the unweighted mean of the two input values.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PETSc：Neumann 零空間與相容右端項
related.titleEn: PETSc: Neumann nullspaces and compatible right-hand sides
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有同步、數值篩檢與對應科學診斷共同合格才放行。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Release requires synchronization, numerical screening and the relevant scientific diagnostics together.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「PETSc：Neumann 零空間與相容右端項」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付零空間驗證、相容性帳本、雙殘差與規範選擇說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate PETSc: Neumann nullspaces and compatible right-hand sides using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver nullspace verification, compatibility ledgers, both residual definitions and a gauge-selection statement documenting any change to the mathematical problem.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算十五秒內移動 900 m，再除子格寬；獨立計父網格的同一指標。
b=[2,0] 的平均為一，移除 [1,1] 得 [1,−1]；算移除向量範數並保留原資料。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate travel of 900 m during a child step and divide by child spacing. Independently compute the parent indicator and explain why proportional refinement preserves this particular horizontal transport ratio.

Find mean one for b=[2,0], remove [1,1] and obtain [1,-1]. Compute the removed-vector norm while retaining the original load, making the mathematical modification visible rather than overwriting its provenance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
